items.title: 中共中央紀委：薄熙來前搭檔黃奇帆接受調查
items.description: 黃奇帆擔任重慶市長期間，上級薄熙來與同僚王立軍系列醜聞爆發。離任後，他仍以經濟學家身分周遊演說。
items.content:
中共中央紀委：薄熙來前搭檔黃奇帆接受調查
中共反貪腐機關宣佈，已離任多時的前重慶市市長黃奇帆被立案調查。
中共中央紀律檢查委員會星期二（10月13日）宣佈，74歲的黃奇帆「涉嫌嚴重違紀違法」，正接受紀律審查和監察調查。通報一如慣例未說明其具體罪嫌，但一般意味著是貪污腐敗。
黃奇帆2001年起於重慶任職，2010年起出任市長兼中共市委副書記，不久後便爆發市委書記薄熙來與副市長兼公安局長王立軍系列醜聞。黃奇帆任職市長直到2016年底。
黃奇帆退任市長後仍不時作為經濟學家發表公開演說。來自香港的報導稱，他原定於兩週後在杭州的一場演講被突然取消。報導發表後不久，當局便公佈其被調查的消息。
香港《明報》星期二報導，這場由當地一家銀行主辦的論壇，原定於10月26日在杭州一間五星級酒店舉行，邀請黃奇帆擔任主講嘉賓。主辦方介紹黃奇帆為「復旦大學特聘教授、中國國際經濟交流中心副理事長」。
報導指出，黃奇帆所屬的這家交流中心，其理事長近期因受賄等原因被判刑。中紀委的通報並未說明黃奇帆被調查與此有否關連，但通報對其稱呼為「重慶市委原副書記、市政府原市長」。
從浦東到重慶：政壇「不倒翁」黃奇帆倒下了
黃奇帆祖籍浙江諸暨，1952年5月生。
黃奇帆的官場經歷頗為傳奇。暫時仍可閱讀的官方媒體簡歷顯示，他在文化大革命爆發後的1968年，進入上海焦化廠擔任焦爐車間工人，一直升任至工程師。
他是在文革這段時間經推薦，以工農兵學員身份上了大學。官方履歷稱，黃奇帆擁有工商管理碩士學位，以及研究員資格。
黃奇帆日後在官場上卻展現出高超的財技，更歷經薄熙來、孫政才兩任重慶市委書記先後落馬，卻長期未受波及。
黃奇帆的仕途，可以概括為上海和重慶兩個篇章。
改革開放實施後的1983，他進入上海市體制，開始從事經濟相關工作。
1990年4月22日，黃奇帆接到中共上海市委組織部通知：由朱鎔基提名，市委常委會審議通過，任命他到浦東開發辦擔任副主任，第二天就去報到。這是他事後的回憶，他本人在不同場合對日期的說法略有出入，有時也說是4月21日。
黃奇帆是朱鎔基開發浦東新區早期最重要的幕僚。1990年的浦東新區一無所有，只有政策，資金有限。黃奇帆籌建了外高橋、金橋、陸家嘴三家國有開發公司，政府把連片土地劃撥給這三家公司，土地折算成資本金後進行股權融資，再把融到的資金存入銀行，換取數倍的貸款。
這種做法，讓最初注入三家公司的不到1億元人民幣資金，膨脹到數十億元的規模。浦東開發才剛起步，就憑這套辦法取得了在當年看來不可思議的啟動資金。
1990年代中期，黃奇帆進一步主掌整個上海的國有企業改革。在上海的國企改革中，他對資產進行打包重組，並借助金融手段，讓上海眾多國有企業度過危機，形成幾個大型國企集團。
這使得，浦東開發與國企改革，朱鎔基時代兩項極為重要的經濟改革，他都參與其中。
這些經歷，讓黃奇帆在中國改革開放初期那個規則模糊和經驗不足的年代，屢屢創造出令人眼前一亮的成績。
2001年，他調任重慶，擔任副市長。當時中國地方政府仍在摸索運作模式，尤其在分稅制改革之後，地方政府的創收能力大幅下降。
剛到重慶的黃奇帆，先透過市政府旗下的城投公司改造爛尾樓項目，又接手有爭議的BOT大橋（民間以建設—經營—轉讓模式興建大橋）等項目，讓城投公司不斷壯大，也盤活了城裡一些爛尾項目。
接著，他以城投公司為平台，把政府資產注入其中，擴大城投公司的固定資產規模，以此向各大銀行高額舉債，使重慶市政府的可支配資金大幅攀升。他因此被稱為「重慶財神」。
此後，黃奇帆在重慶繼續擴大這套模式，組建了八大投資集團，全部隸屬市政府，為重慶市的建設帶來了大量的資金。這套城投債模式，逐步在中國各地方，遍地開花。
2009年底，薄熙來出任中共市委書記，主政重慶，與當時的市長王鴻舉矛盾尖銳，王鴻舉最後主動辭職下台，黃奇帆順利坐上市長的位置。黃奇帆曾形容與薄熙來的搭檔「如魚得水」。
黃奇帆繼續發揮他盤活地方資源的本事，薄熙來則專注於「唱紅打黑」，兩人搭檔，形成了所謂的「重慶模式」。
但這一模式的神話，在重慶市公安局長王立軍2012年2月駕車駛入美國駐成都總領事館的那一刻，戛然而止。
當時中國輿論場對這起事件諱莫如深，海外和香港媒體卻流傳一種說法：薄熙來沒有第一時間親自出面，而是派黃奇帆市長率領70輛警車連夜趕赴成都要人。這一說法未經證實，黃奇帆本人公開否認。
黃奇帆後來在接受鳳凰網採訪時說：「就你們說我帶了70輛警車去，那是子虛烏有、胡說八道！我是一輛車帶了我的一個秘書長去的。結果別人說有那麼多警車，那上面的牌照是川警，是四川的！」
薄熙來去職後，副國級的張德江在重慶過渡了八個月。官方的說法是，張德江在特殊時期領導重慶，穩定了大局；外界則普遍認為，他的任務之一是清理薄熙來的影響。黃奇帆在這場風波中留任，並在2012年11月張德江離任的大會上兩度落淚。
接著，年輕的孫政才接任重慶市委書記。孫政才當時被外界廣泛視為習近平之後的最高接班人人選，前途看漲，但2017年7月，中央將他調離重慶，並由中央紀委對他立案審查，他其後被判處無期徒刑。
孫政才在重慶任職期間，黃奇帆與他共事約四年，依然未受波及。黃奇帆2016年12月卸任市長，2017年任全國人大財經委員會副主任委員，2018年卸任。2017年中共十九大後，他不再是中央委員，至此退出政壇。
退休後，他轉以學者身分活動，成為中國各類經濟論壇的常客，也會在重要政策發布的時點撰文表態，成為經濟界一把極為響亮的聲音。
長期以來，黃奇帆被中國輿論視為重慶政壇的「不倒翁」。先後與薄熙來、孫政才這兩位極具爭議性的直屬上級搭檔，兩人相繼出事，他卻在薄案、孫案的風暴中都未受波及。退休之後，他反而在各類論壇上高調宣傳自己的經濟主張，獲得越來越多關注。
他當年引以為傲的城投公司和地方債模式，如今在中國受到反思與檢視。他留下的龐大地方債務，以及房地產模式退潮後的地方治理難題，在潮水退去之後逐漸浮現。
而他在政壇「不倒翁」的形象，卻在退休九年後，被立案調查，倒在了無人想得到之時。

items.title: 華為尊界V800事件：一場煞車測試如何演變成中國輿論風暴
items.description: 近期，中國知名車媒懂車帝發布對尊界V800的實測影片，顯示多輛測試車在緊急制動過程中出現制動踏板支架斷裂，事件迅速引發輿論關注。
items.content:
華為尊界V800事件：一場煞車測試如何演變成中國輿論風暴
中國知名車媒懂車帝近日發布對電動車尊界V800的測試影片，顯示多輛測試車在緊急制動過程中制動踏板支架斷裂。事件迅速引發輿論關注，但相關影片隨後在多個平台被下架，在官方定調之前，多數主流媒體亦保持沉默。
影片10月8日發佈後快速衝上微博熱搜，僅次日，測評影片陸續無法在多個平台正常查看，多家主流媒體亦未持續跟進相關爭議，直至11日中共官方《人民日報》發文，才再次帶動中國多家官方媒體集中跟進。
香港浸會大學傳理學院副教授閭丘露薇對BBC中文分析說，有別於此前的審查主要針對政治，由官方直接出手，此次華為尊界V800事件中，核心是商業利益，執行的是平台，背後的推力是企業的影響力。
「說得準確點，這不算傳統審查的延續，而是商業力量借助政治敏感性，達到了類似審查的效果。」
涉事車款屬於科技巨頭華為的「鴻蒙智行」版圖，是華為和江淮汽車（JAC）聯合開發、定位為百萬級別超豪華智能電動車。此前，華為亦與賽力斯（Seres）合作，推出問界系列汽車。
事件發生後，10月8日和9日，江淮汽車股價連續兩日跌停，市值蒸發超過百億人民幣。
煞車被踩斷：誰的問題？
尊界目前已推出三款車型，分別是售價70.8萬元人民幣（10.58萬美元；339.93萬元新台幣）起步的尊界S800，售價76.6萬元起步的尊界V800，以及售價64.8萬元起的尊界V680。
其中，V800車型8月5日正式上市，8月底至9月初才完成首批車主交付。
10月8日，懂車帝在多平台發布測評影片，稱自購3輛全新尊界V800，進行100公里／小時至零的緊急制動測試，測試中，三台車均出現制動踏板支架斷裂情況，且斷裂位置高度一致。
懂車帝與影片社交平台抖音、抖音國際版（TikTok）同屬字節跳動（ByteDance）旗下品牌，提供汽車資訊、價格參考以至於二手車交易服務。其官方公佈日均活躍用戶超過1000萬人。
制動煞車這樣最基礎的用車安全問題在中國快速引起討論，很多民眾深表擔憂。
在微博上，有民眾提出：「斷了就是斷了，難道拍不到就是不存在？僅憑一個人的力就可以踩斷，哪怕只是斷一次，就說明安全冗余不夠，就是質量不過關，沒什麼好洗的，別說什麼標準不標準的，說明標準也有問題。」
亦有民眾對華為、江淮汽車的權責分工展開討論：到底煞車出問題屬於華為有問題、還是江淮汽車有問題。
新浪微博CEO王高飛通過個人微博帳戶發評：「這是江淮，華為賦能還管賦能怎麼造煞車踏板？」
尊界汽車在當天發佈回應，稱尊界汽車的制動系統按照高於國家標準、高於行業標準的要求完成全流程開發和驗證，且「首批車輛交付以來，在用戶實際使用場景中，未發生制動踏板支架底座斷裂故障」。
聲明亦指出，「即便是非標準的極端測試工況，我們仍希望為用戶提供更高的安全冗餘：我們將進一步優化該部件設計，並為已交付用戶提供免費升級選擇」。
10月13日上午，尊界汽車再發回應，稱第三方檢測機構對V800制動踏板檢驗結果合格，「做加嚴檢驗至縱向力3000N（牛頓；306公斤）後，未出現裂紋和損壞」。
輿論被「捂嘴」：誰在管控？
事件至此尚是關於車輛安全本身的討論、尊界V800是否值得被信任，然而隨之更值得關注的是，從這時開始，懂車帝關於尊界V800的測評視頻開始從多個平台上消失：中國串流平台Bilibili上顯示「稿件失效」，微信視頻號也顯示「經用戶投訴並經平台審核，涉及違規內容」，微博相關影片無法查看，只留下抖音上用戶自己保存、重新上載的影片可供觀看。中國官方新華社亦刪除了對華為尊界V800事件的報導。
直到10月11日，中共《人民日報》客戶端發文，標題是《四部門聯手，對速成車說「不」！》，中共北京市委機關報《北京日報》旗下微信號《長安街知事》亦同日發文評論尊界測評事件，將輿論焦點集中在用車安全問題上。
從這裡開始之後的幾小時內，中國大量官方各級媒體集中跟進：觀察者網、九派新聞、《新京報》、《中國青年報》、中新社等再次開始發佈尊界V800煞車制動相關討論，把討論集中卡在民眾最為關心的安全問題上，對品牌方、刪文和下架影片隻字不提。
10月12日上午，中共浙江省委宣傳部官方微信號發文《尊界V800風波需要一個真相》，質詢到底是車有問題，還是自購三台車用於測評的懂車帝刻意製造問題、嘩眾取寵。這篇報導被胡錫進轉發，他在微博指出尊界和鴻蒙智行需要直面批評和質疑。
10月13日上午，浙江宣傳部官方微信號再度發文《品牌飯圈化的歪風該踩剎車》，影射尊界V800「不允許」批評一事，稱「原本普通的產品測評、體驗吐槽、行業探討，很容易脫離客觀理性的討論軌道，演變為水火不容的陣營對立」，將相關討論沉寂的幾天概括為「飯圈化」的操作。
輿情學者：「近乎審查」
香港浸會大學傳理學院新聞系的閭丘露薇博士指出，平台先限制、官媒未及時介入的關鍵是企業的公關能力和議價能力。平台主要是從商業角度考慮，被評測的企業越強勢，平台就越有顧忌。
閭丘露薇對BBC中文指出，以華為為例，它一向都很強勢，又很擅長把自身和「民族品牌」、「國家聲譽」綁定在一起，所以即便沒有直接的商業利益，平台也會擔心惹上政治風險——所以直接先限流、下架，求一個穩妥。
這樣由平台、企業、政府三方權力關係下臨時形成的「先平台處理、後官方定調」模式，影響了公眾所能接收到的資訊平衡，也使得媒體直接自我審查，以避開強勢企業，監督功能也逐漸萎縮。
閭丘露薇亦指出，同樣值得注意的是官媒在一些事件上的表態並不等於他們直接收到了中共中央宣傳部（中宣部）的介入指令，尤其是這種商業事件——可能這些商業事件只是媒體增加收入的來源之一，但對於平台來說，這些舉動會被自動看作官方信號。
「所以要看是否有網信辦（中國國家互聯網信息辦公室）禁令，這個我們從外面看不出來，唯一可以使用的方法，是看全部滅聲，還是只是部分。」閭丘露薇這樣說。
華為的輿情處理
過去幾年，華為在中國輿論場上的地位出現了明顯變化。隨著中美科技競爭升溫以及美國多輪制裁，華為逐漸被部分官方和民族主義輿論塑造成中國科技自主創新的代表企業。
在社交媒體上，圍繞華為的討論往往不只涉及產品本身，也經常被賦予產業競爭、國家實力和科技自主等更宏大的政治意義。
與此同時，一些涉及華為產品、技術或商業策略的負面爭議，近年來屢次引發外界對中國網絡輿論環境的討論。「華為製造」在中國社交媒體上亦成為一個調侃用的新名詞，用戶用以調侃難以言說的產品質素。
部分媒體報道、產品評測或批評性內容曾出現刪除、限流或迅速降溫的情況。2019年，華為前員工李洪元被羈押251天後獲不起訴的事件，曾成為中國互聯網罕見的大規模企業負面輿情案例。事件曝光初期引發廣泛討論，但多家媒體報道和部分網絡討論其後消失，引發外界對涉及華為議題輿論管理方式的關注。
同樣的輿論處理方式在接下來幾年裡重複出現：2023年，現任華為常務董事余承東和小鵬汽車創始人何小鵬展開智能駕駛的自動緊急剎車（AEB）辯論，討論中牽涉到多起華為問界車型的事故，期間，測評人士常遭大規模網路攻擊，測評內容也常被投訴、下架。
但外界通常難以判斷相關處置究竟源於平台自行決策、企業投訴，還是更高層面的輿論管理要求。由於相關機制缺乏透明度，事件往往伴隨大量猜測。
閭丘露薇說：「規則沒有明確寫出來，平台只能『寧緊勿鬆』，自己先做過濾。這種做法是在這樣的環境下必然出現的，不是個別平台的偶然選擇。」

items.title: 中國民兵船「首現台灣東部海域」意味著什麼？
items.description: 一艘被辨識為中國海上民兵船的漁船，8月在台灣東部外海與另外兩艘中國船隻共同活動。軍事學者向BBC中文分析，這類船隻可能有海上監控、情報蒐集等任務。
items.content:
從台海到太平洋：中國民兵船「首現台灣東部海域」意味著什麼？
  - Author, 蔣宜婷
  - Role, BBC中文記者
  - Reporting from, 台北報導
- Published
- 閱讀時間: 6 分鐘
路透社近日報導，一艘被辨識為中國海上民兵船的漁船，今年8月在台灣東部太平洋外海與另外兩艘中國船隻共同活動，並稱這是此類船隻「首次」被發現在台灣東部海域出沒。
軍事學者向BBC中文分析，這類船隻可能承擔海上監控、情報蒐集等任務。由於近年台灣社會對海底電纜安全格外關注，也有部分專家討論，此類船隻可能涉及對海底基礎設施的偵察活動。
美國國務院一名發言人向台灣媒體表示，美方持續關注中國在台灣以東海域的活動，並批評中國相關行動具有破壞性，呼籲北京停止對台施壓。
中國外交部週一（10月12日）間接回應稱，中方船艦在台灣東部活動「正當合法，無可非議」。
隨著中國近年持續增加在台灣東部海域的活動，分析認為，北京正透過海警、科研船及海上民兵船的共同運作，逐步擴大在相關海域的存在，並強化其法律與海洋權益主張。
接近台灣海域「鄰接區」
根據路透社檢視、民營培訓機構台灣安捷航空（Apex Aviation）發布的偵察報告，該公司一架偵察機於8月中旬在台灣東部、花蓮外海約30多海里處發現一支中國船隻編隊。
編隊由三艘船隻組成，包括漁船「閩福鼎漁07902」、一艘中國海警船及一艘科研船。
兩名台灣不具名的官員向路透社證實，三艘船隻當時正在台灣東部外海活動，並表示「閩福鼎漁07902」屬於中國海上民兵體系的一部分。
值得留意的是，儘管相關船隻並未進入台灣限制水域，但其活動位置已相當接近24海里（44公里）鄰接區（Contiguous Zone；毗連區）。
依台灣法規，外國船舶若在鄰接區內從事未經許可的漁撈或其他違法行為，海巡署得依法進行廣播驅離、登船檢查或採取其他處置措施。
受訪官員向路透社表示，台灣方面已加強對相關船隻的監控；海巡署回應，相關中國船舶活動都在限制水域外，全程掌握。
台灣國防部長顧立雄週一則表示，中共民兵船、海警船若有任何越界行為，均由海巡署作為主要驅離與執法單位，海軍則依支援協定提供協助。
中國外交部週一回應路透社提問時，並未正面回應「民兵船」之說，但發言人毛寧稱：「中國在台灣島以東海域擁有專屬經濟區和大陸架，中方在該海域開展活動完全是中國主權權利，和管轄權範圍內的事，正當合法，無可非議。」
「在這一海域挑起事端、破壞穩定，從來不是中方。」
針對美國國務院評論，毛寧重申北京所稱「台灣問題是中國內政，不容任何外部干涉」，要求美國「慎重處理台灣問題」。
「民兵船」是什麼？
中國大陸的所謂「海上民兵」由漁民及漁船組成，是在必要時配合中國軍方與海警執行任務的的「準軍事力量」。由於屬於「編制外、體制內」，也常被稱為中國的「第三海軍」或「小藍人」（Little Blue Men）。
台灣國防安全研究院委任副研究員揭仲向BBC中文表示，從外觀來看，海上民兵船與一般漁船往往沒有明顯差異，平時也可能從事漁業活動。
「但它們通常會在官方休漁期間持續活動，而且船上的天線往往比一般漁船更多。」他說，這些船隻通常配備較完善的通訊、衛星定位及其他電子設備，具備執行特定任務的能力。
揭仲指出，中共出版物曾披露，中國海上民兵船由沿海各省軍區負責編組與管理，平時以漁船身分活動，但可依任務需求前往特定海域，執行跟監、情蒐偵察、水下探測等任務，並與海警、海軍等相互配合。
「由於具備民用船舶身分，較不易引發警戒，也能前往軍用或官方艦艇不宜進入的敏感海域，執行監視、偵察和情報蒐集任務，拓寬共軍的情報渠道。」
根據台灣國防安全研究院的研究，中國海上民兵主要可分為兩類：一類是專門建造或改裝、具有較強任務能力的專業海上民兵船；另一類則是透過政府補貼動員、在特定時期執行政策或維權任務的漁船。
「首次」現身東部？
路透社此次揭露案例，稱是首次有中國海上民兵船被公開發現在「台灣東部海域」活動。
不過目前為止，台灣官方並未證實該艘出現在東部海域的漁船為民兵船。
海巡署回覆BBC中文查詢表示，相關中國船舶活動均位於台灣限制水域外，海巡署已運用聯合情監偵手段，全天候監控中國艦船在台灣周邊海域動態。
事實上，台灣政府近年持續關注中國海上民兵的發展。
今年4月，台灣國家安全局長蔡明彥在立法院報告時表示，中共海上民兵規模已達數千艘，且數量仍持續增加。他並指出，近年中共歷次大型軍演，幾乎都可見海上民兵參與行動，
海洋委員會副主任委員兼海巡署署長張忠龍表示，自2023年至今，曾出現在台灣周邊海域、被研判具有海上民兵背景的中國船隻已超過100艘，相關單位均已列冊追蹤與監控。
揭仲指出，過去也曾有疑似中國海上民兵船出現在台灣東部海域的相關案例。
他指出，2021年7月30日，兩艘中國籍大型漁船「瓊三亞漁72107」與「瓊三亞漁72108」進入蘭嶼附近海域，距離岸邊約10海里，因涉嫌越界遭海巡署船艦驅離。他認為，這兩艘船舶很可能並非單純漁船，而是肩負情報蒐集任務的海上民兵船。
揭仲提出兩項觀察作為依據：其一，當時正值中國官方實施休漁期間，兩艘船卻出現在遠離母港的蘭嶼海域；其二，從海巡署當年公布的畫面可見，船上安裝的衛星通訊天線數量明顯多於一般漁船。
他並指出，當時台灣中山科學研究院正在屏東九鵬基地周邊海域進行多項武器實彈射擊，而蘭嶼正位於相關演訓區域的東南側。雖然無法直接證實其任務內容，但從時間與地點來看，不排除這些船隻具有蒐集演訓資訊的目的。
民兵船游弋台灣東部目的為何？
台灣官員告訴路透社，8月出現的民兵船當時正「配合中國海警的海上騷擾演練」行動，其目的是「進行實質騷擾」。
台灣國防部給路透社的聲明中表示，中國正「以執法和科研為掩護進行騷擾，試圖在非衝突情況下擴大其作業範圍，製造實質管轄權的假象」。
部分台灣專家認為這是中方對台灣實施灰色地帶侵擾的一環，可能具備蓄意破壞海底電纜等意圖。
台灣人工智慧實驗室創辦人杜奕瑾日前在臉書（Facebook）發文指出，若將台灣周邊海底地形圖與海底電纜分布圖進行比對，可觀察到在東西向及南北向海底山脈形成的淺水區，有多條國際海纜通過。
他認為，從船隻航跡來看，三艘船曾在相關海域反覆活動、並「來回尋找攻擊（海纜）的地區」。
目前沒有公開證據顯示這些船隻的活動與海底電纜破壞行動存在直接關聯，但相關推測仍引發高度關注。
台灣近年多次發生海底電纜受損事件，使海纜安全成為重要安全議題。
2025年初，台灣國家安全局曾表示，海纜毀損已成為「境外敵對勢力」對台灰色地帶威脅的新型態。其報告指出，過去三年台灣周邊海纜平均每年發生約7至8次斷纜事件，人為因素造成的比例有所增加。
其中最受矚目的案件發生於2025年2月。具有中資背景的權宜輪「宏泰58」涉嫌破壞連接台灣本島與澎湖的「台澎三號」海底電纜。其中國籍王姓船長後來因違反《電信管理法》、毀損海底電纜而遭法院判處有期徒刑三年。
「更像是演練跟準備」
軍事學者揭仲分析，這艘民兵船在中共海警船艦與科研船的陪同下來到台灣海域，除了部分學者擔憂中方可能藉此「演練」未來在海警掩護下，由民兵船執行海底電纜破壞任務外，另一種可能性則是：為擴大海上民兵在台灣東部海域的活動範圍預作準備。
他指出，漁船作為海上民兵的主要載體，具有民用船舶身分，因此與軍艦或海警船相比，行動受到的限制較少，也使執法單位應對時必須更加謹慎。若台灣海巡船艦對相關船隻進行驅離，中國海警船則可能介入應對，使海上民兵得以撤離或持續執行任務。
揭仲認為，北京也可能藉由增加民兵船在台灣東部海域的活動，「塑造中國漁船在相關海域從事經濟活動的事實，」進一步為其海洋權益主張提供依據。
他指出，中國過去在釣魚台（日本稱尖閣諸島）主權爭議中，也曾動員漁船及公務船進入周邊海域活動，以配合其海洋權益主張。
今年5月底至6月間，中國以日本與菲律賓啟動專屬經濟區（EEZ）劃界談判為由，宣稱對台灣東部部分海域擁有管轄權以及「專屬經濟區和主權」，並派遣公務船與海事力量前往相關海域，展開所謂「海上交通專項執法行動」。
對此，台灣政府強調兩岸互不隸屬，台灣依據《聯合國海洋法公約》在東部海域享有專屬經濟區賦予的主權權利與管轄權，中國無權在台灣專屬經濟區內對合法航行船舶採取執法作為。
頻率與強度升高
揭仲指出，海上民兵船雖不如軍艦部署那樣直接對台灣構成軍事壓力，但自中國於2015年推動軍事改革以來，其角色日益受到重視，相關動向也更加值得關注。
台灣官員向路透社表示，他們認為這次事件是中國正利用重疊的軍事、準軍事及民用資產，演練潛在的海上封鎖。
2019年，美國智庫戰略與國際研究中心（CSIS）文章曾指出，中國從事準軍事工作的捕魚船隊已成為南沙群島最大的力量來源。
CSIS轄下計畫「亞洲海事透明倡議」（AMTI）今年初發布的報告則指出，2025年中國海上民兵在南中國海的部署規模創歷史新高，每日平均數為241艘。其活動主要集中在涉及中菲主權爭議的美濟礁（Mischief Reef）和牛軛礁（Whitsun Reef）。
今年1月，《紐約時報》報導指出，2025年底至2026年初，中國漁業活動展現出高度組織化的特徵。中國對海上民兵船的運用，似乎從過去較為零星的點狀侵擾，轉向更大範圍的區域性部署。該報導披露的現象，恰好發生在中國對台軍演前後，因而受到關注。
台灣國防安全研究院網路安全與決策推演研究所委任副研究員林超倫在一篇研究文章中指出，儘管目前尚無明確證據顯示中國已在台海周邊常態性、大規模部署海上民兵，但中國漁船長期在台灣西北部海域及金門、馬祖等外島周邊活動，甚至在禁漁期間仍持續越界作業，顯示「相關船隻的活動頻率與強度正逐步升高」。
林超倫指出，自2022年8月美國眾議院議長南希·佩洛西（Nancy Pelosi；裴洛西、波洛西）訪台後，中國民兵船配合解放軍與海警船進行多次共同軍事演練，「顯示正朝向更專業化的方向發展」。
他還說，值得留意的是，近年中國的灰色地帶行動已不僅依賴海上民兵船，也結合各類民用船舶資源，包括滾裝貨輪、工程船與郵輪等。

items.title: 廣州開發電玩遊戲「喚醒」威爾士民間傳說潛力
items.description: 開發商廣州深藍互動表示，威爾斯神話與該遊戲的主題產生了強烈共鳴。
items.content:
廣州開發電玩遊戲「喚醒」威爾士民間傳說潛力
  - Author, 奧斯卡·愛德華茲（Oscar Edwards）
  - Role, BBC威爾斯分部（BBC Wales）
- Published
- 閱讀時間: 4 分鐘
中國角色扮演遊戲中出現一名名為蕾安儂（Rhiannon）的威爾士（威爾斯）角色，或許是人們最意想不到的地方之一，但《重返未來：1999》正是如此。
這款以20世紀為背景的時間旅行策略遊戲，由中國廣州開發商深藍互動（Bluepoch）出品。該公司表示，威爾士文化有許多層面都與遊戲的世界觀和故事「產生了強烈共鳴」。
配音員汪佳宜（Rebecca Wang）表示，學習這門語言的一些特點，例如大量使用字母W，雖然充滿挑戰，但也是一個「有趣的過程」。
經營遊戲網站的亞倫·伊萊亞斯（Aaron Elias）表示，威爾士歷史在遊戲世界中具有「尚未開發的巨大潛力」，而更多元的呈現有助提升這個國家的知名度。
據深藍互動介紹，蕾安儂是一名隱居生活的神秘馴鳥師。
她與一群黑酒鳥（Adar Llwch Gwin）共同生活。這種生物見於威爾士神話，是體型巨大的鳥類，智慧極高，並能遵從人類指令。
深藍互動聯合創辦人 KK 表示，由於遊戲所處的世界是「真實存在魔法」的世界，因此團隊喜歡「從威爾士神話中汲取靈感」，而這也讓威爾士成為一個「自然而然的連結點」。
KK 補充說：「我們覺得威爾士的民間傳說、地方傳統和文化特色，特別契合這個故事的主題。」
KK 表示，蕾安儂的造型融入了反映其背景的「威爾士與神秘學元素」，包括結合牧羊人與馴鳥人特色的服飾設計。
他補充說：「我們亦參考了更廣泛的凱爾特視覺傳統，包括歐甘字母（Ogham script，中世紀威爾士語、愛爾蘭語字母）、『生命之樹』（Tree of Life），以及受凱爾特文化（Celtic culture）啟發的儀式圖騰。」
KK 表示，玩家對蕾安儂反應良好，他亦留意到網上出現不少討論，探究「反映在她性格不同側面中的傳說與神話」。
他說：「如果未來出現合適的故事與文化主題，我們當然願意透過未來的新角色進一步探索威爾士文化。」
遊戲中的蕾安儂由美籍亞裔中、英、日三語配音員汪佳宜配音。
她最初對飾演這名角色有所猶豫，因為自己對威爾士語「毫不熟悉」，但工作室告訴她，遊戲只會在部分地方採用威爾士語，以吸引全球受眾，最終說服了她接下這個角色。
她說：「我很快便意識到，威爾士語很喜歡把 W 當作元音字母使用。我必須學習如何發音這些詞語。」
「有些詞需要用到較多喉音，例如 bechan，這是一個表示親暱的詞語，意思是『小寶貝』。」
汪佳宜表示，這是一個「引人入勝」的學習過程，因為「明明是英文字母，卻不遵循英文規則」。
身為一名自認熱愛語言的人，她利用 TikTok、YouTube 影片，以及方言教練協助自己掌握這些詞語，並形容這是一個「有趣的過程」。
汪佳宜表示，這段經歷激發了她對威爾士的興趣，希望在不久將來計劃到威爾士旅行。
專門推廣包含威爾士元素電子遊戲網站「遊戲中的威爾士」（Wales in Games）經營者亞倫·伊萊亞斯表示，就威爾士故事與角色而言，「仍有大量尚未開發的潛力」。
他補充說：「希望大家對這類遊戲投入更多關注，最終能促成威爾士文化在遊戲中更好的呈現。」
亞倫表示，威爾士歷史特別適合作為冒險遊戲題材，而開發者也已經意識到，「世界上值得探索的神話不只有北歐、希臘和埃及神話」。
他認為，正如《馬比諾吉昂傳說》（Tales from the Mabinogion；開發中電玩遊戲）所展示的那樣，威爾士文化能夠帶來「獨特的世界觀、角色與敘事」。
他補充說：「英國一些最古老的書面故事已有數百年歷史，而且完全以威爾士語寫成。」
亞倫認為，電子遊戲中的威爾士元素有能力像位於蘇格蘭愛丁堡的 Rockstar 在備受期待的《俠盜獵車手6》（Grand Theft Auto 6, GTA 6）發售前所做到的那樣，讓威爾士「登上世界舞台」。
他說：「如今電子遊戲產業的規模已經超越電影業。」
「我們希望看到更多威爾士文化的呈現，吸引更多人認識威爾士、關注威爾士。」
來自卡那封（Caernarfon）的巴里·普里查德（Barry Pritchard）已遊玩《重返未來：1999》數年。他表示，雖然部分發音「有點不太準確」，但看到自己喜愛的遊戲加入威爾士語元素，仍令他十分高興。
他說：「很少有人會以任何形式嘗試使用威爾士語。」
「所以至少能看到這樣的嘗試，已經令人感到欣慰。」
巴里表示，在遊戲領域中，威爾士的「文化足跡較小」，而威爾士口音亦「不是經常能聽到的」。
他說：「老實說，在遊戲裡聽到這些內容，確實讓我會心微笑。」
他表示，遊戲角色會提到威爾士地點，例如「卡那封的女巫市集（witches market of Caernarfon）」。
「威爾士大多數人都知道這座城鎮，但能在遊戲中聽到相關內容，仍然令人眼界大開。而且如果某些作品與威爾士語有關，我也更有可能去了解看看。」
巴里表示，聽到威爾士語並不是他玩這款遊戲的唯一原因，但「有時候，只是看到自己的國家獲得這樣的呈現，就已經很美好」。

items.title: 中期選舉前夕油價降不下，特朗普難題加劇
items.description: 隨著選舉日的臨近，總統將目光轉向海外，尋求協助解決國內緊迫的問題。
items.content:
分析：中期選舉前夕油價降不下，特朗普難題加劇
  - Author, 安東尼·祖切爾（Anthony Zurcher）
  - Role, BBC駐北美記者
- Published
- 閱讀時間: 3 分鐘
距離決定國會控制權的中期選舉僅剩幾週，美國選民已開始在一些關鍵州份投票。總統特朗普則把目光轉向海外——尤其是俄羅斯。他希望借助外力，解決他最緊迫的問題之一：油價。
但世界局勢鮮少提供簡單答案，其他地方的發展，有可能破壞他降低燃油價格的努力，在帶來任何政治效益之前就已受挫。
上週五，特朗普宣布與俄羅斯總統普京達成一項新協議，俄羅斯將在未來數月內，向美國提供數億噸柴油。這個決定開啟了一個旋風般的周末。
高昂的能源價格，令美國選民日益不滿，尤其是依賴柴油驅動農業機械、並運送農產品到市場的中西部農業州。
民調顯示，選民認為伊朗戰爭是造成他們困境的主因，對特朗普的整體支持率，尤其是對他處理戰爭和美國經濟方式的認可度，都急劇下降。
特朗普在Truth Social上發文稱，他與俄羅斯達成的協議，將為美國人帶來「更低的價格」，同時他下令財政部，暫停美國對俄羅斯柴油在全球市場的銷售限制。
兩天後，特朗普再次在他的社群媒體上發文，吹噓俄羅斯和烏克蘭之間達成了一項新的能源停火協議。
然而，事實遠比這複雜。
烏克蘭總統澤連斯基表示，他事先並未收到有關該協議的通知，但烏克蘭將遵守協議。俄羅斯方面則保持沉默。週日晚間，俄羅斯對烏克蘭的發電廠發動了新一輪襲擊。
澤連斯基週一語帶諷刺地說：「很明顯，普京根本不看Truth Social。」他補充道：「今年冬天，如果俄羅斯不同意能源停火，我們將作出回應。」
在特朗普的第二個任期內，他和澤連斯基的關係一直起伏不定。這位美國總統對於持續中的衝突，時而怪責俄羅斯，時而怪責烏克蘭，而他此前曾聲稱一旦他重返白宮，這場衝突就能輕易結束。
近日，澤連斯基成為特朗普怒火的主要目標，因為烏克蘭對俄羅斯石油設施的襲擊，加劇了全球能源短缺。
週六，特朗普在白宮告訴記者，烏克蘭是時候選出新總統了。 《金融時報》和CNN均報導，美國已威脅，如果澤連斯基不停止襲擊俄羅斯煉油廠，美國將切斷對烏克蘭的武器銷售和情報共享。特朗普說，澤連斯基「最好立刻停止」。
獨立智庫Pangaea Policy的創始人特里·海恩斯（Terry Haines）告訴 BBC：「我認為，，總統十多年來有公開的紀錄，就是對那些沒有按他的意思、在他要求的時間和方式行事的人，大發雷霆。」
現在看來，特朗普對「能源休戰」的慶祝，或許是他慣用的伎倆，即在協議尚未正式簽署生效前就大肆宣揚。例如，他過去就曾過早宣布中東停火和達成全面和平協議。
無論是總統對外交進展緩慢感到不耐煩，還是為了促成協議而採取的精明談判策略，結果都是引發一場混亂，各方爭相判斷這究竟意味著什麼，以及該如何應對。
各方反應很快就出現了。
加拿大總理馬克·卡尼（Mark Carney）在國際舞台上一直是特朗普的公開批評者，他對能源停火表示「強烈支持」，但譴責柴油協議破壞了歐洲的和平與穩定，並幫助俄羅斯為其「針對烏克蘭的非法、不公正的戰爭」提供資金。
在美國國內，特朗普的柴油宣布也引發了類似的擔憂，甚至包括他所屬共和黨的成員。四位共和黨參議員與民主黨人聯署，呼籲總統「立即撤回決定」。
參議員在周日發表的聲明中寫道：「國會於2022年明確禁止從俄羅斯進口能源，以防止美元資助普京對烏克蘭發動的殘酷戰爭。特朗普總統允許俄羅斯柴油進口到美國的決定，直接違反了這項法律。」
對總統來說，比批評更糟糕的是，宣布停火對柴油價格幾乎沒有影響——柴油價格仍低於歷史最高水平，但每加侖仍遠高於6美元。
同時，隨著俄烏衝突最新變化接連出現，中東爆發的新一輪暴力衝突，無論俄羅斯石油的局勢如何發展，都可能進一步衝擊全球能源市場。
胡塞武裝對沙特阿拉伯發動了一連串襲擊，包括週末對機場和能源基礎設施的襲擊，造成至少13人死亡。這些攻擊有可能使這場持續十年之久的衝突升級，而這場衝突在美伊戰爭期間一直暗流湧動。
美國前駐沙特阿拉伯大使邁克爾·拉特尼（Michael Ratney）向BBC表示：「胡塞武裝是在發出訊息：他們的目標不只是軍事設施，也不只是能源基礎設施，他們還會襲擊可能造成大量傷亡的民用機場。」
他表示，美伊戰爭是該地區所有阿拉伯國家都不願看到的衝突，而胡塞武裝最近的攻勢也在意料之中。鑑於美伊目前長期處於對峙狀態，任何新的敵對行動都可能導致更多地區衝突，並再次推高油價。
他說：「我確實認為，局勢在真正降溫之前，會先變得更糟。」
近幾週來，特朗普把全球能源困境的主因，歸咎於烏克蘭，而非中東。他指出，霍爾木茲海峽的油輪往來已增加，，而此前該海峽曾因伊朗的軍事威脅而實際上遭到封鎖。
但這可能只是一廂情願的想法——試圖說服美國大眾，將他們對能源問題的憤怒，轉移到一場在另一位總統任內爆發的衝突。
不過，同一時期只能有一位總統。美國選民投票時，往往會把責任歸咎於現任掌權者。
經歷了又一個艱難的周末，再次證明全球能源危機沒有簡單的解決辦法，這對美國總統來說，可能就是最壞的消息。

items.title: “蟑螂运动”再起 印度青年为什么抗议？
items.url: https://www.dw.com/zh/蟑螂运动-再起-印度青年为什么抗议？/a-79653322?maca=chi-rss-chi-all-1127-rdf
items.description: 今年5月，印度首席大法官把找不到工作的年轻人称作“蟑螂”，激起印度Z世代怒火，并促使他们成立“蟑螂人民党”（CJP）。如今时隔近半年，“蟑螂运动”再度风起云涌，显示印度年轻人对政府的不满加深。
items.content:
“蟑螂运动”再起 印度青年为什么抗议？
2026年10月13日
（德国之声中文网）周一（10月12日），新德里有数千名示威者游行至最高法院，要求印度首席选举委员古马尔（Gyanesh Kumar）下台，并就选举名册修订的争议向最高法院提出请愿。
自10月以来，印度首都新德里连日动荡，起因是一项始于去年的选举名册修订作业，印度选举委员会从选民名册中删除超过1亿3000万个姓名。该委员会表示，相关修订旨在清除选民名册中的错误，例如已故人士、已永久移居海外者的姓名，以及重复登记资料；同时避免“将非法外籍移民列入名册”。
拓展阅读——“蟑螂”运动领导者与政府会谈：印度青年为何走上街头？
质疑修订有利执政党 抗议活动遭警方取缔
然而，批评者认为，选委会的作为早已超出上述范围。这项修订可能有利于总理莫迪所属的印度人民党（BJP），并导致穆斯林选民及其他少数族群受到不成比例的影响，因这些群体较不太支持以印度教民族主义为主轴的执政党。印度选举委员会与印度人民党均否认相关指控。
“蟑螂人民党”原定10日在简塔曼塔天文台（Jantar Mantar）举行示威，警方却以抗议活动未获批准、属“非法集会”为由镇压群众，并拘捕了才刚下飞机的该党创办人迪普克（Abhijeet Dipke）等3人；他们于隔天获释。不过，在13日的集会，再有该党青年领袖被捕。
简塔曼塔成“蟑螂运动”重要据点
简塔曼塔天文台是“蟑螂运动”的重要抗议场所，CJP在今年7月针对印度考试制度发起示威时，便是在此处；该场抗议后来迫使印度教育部长辞职，这被视为“蟑螂运动”取得的重大胜利，也是莫迪政府面对民众抗议时做出的罕见让步。
周一，CJP曾向警方发出最后通牒，要求政府容许民众在简塔曼塔天文台示威，并确定好日期与时间，但警方改指定了其他的替代抗议场所。
迪普克13日在X平台发文，同时标记了莫迪的帐号：“你没办法撤销民众的反抗。”

items.title: 特朗普宣布“能源停火”后 乌称能源设施遭俄袭击
items.url: https://www.dw.com/zh/特朗普宣布-能源停火-后-乌称能源设施遭俄袭击/a-79652601?maca=chi-rss-chi-all-1127-rdf
items.description: 在与俄罗斯达成柴油协议后，美国总统特朗普宣布基辅与莫斯科之间已达成一项“能源停火”安排。仅仅几个小时后乌称其能源设施再遭到袭击。与此同时，欧盟批准了针对莫斯科有史以来规模最大的制裁措施。
items.content:
特朗普宣布“能源停火”后 乌指责俄继续空袭 欧盟加码制裁
2026年10月13日
（德国之声中文网）据路透社报道，乌克兰总统泽连斯基周一（10月12日）表示，俄罗斯在对乌克兰各地发动造成死伤的空袭期间，至少袭击了六处能源目标。这表明，俄罗斯无意遵守美国总统特朗普宣布的能源停火安排。
泽连斯基通过视频连线向波兰一场会议发表讲话时，指出两处遭袭目标分别是一处天然气设施和一座加油站，两者均遭到俄罗斯无人机袭击。
泽连斯基在社交媒体上表示，俄罗斯对能源设施发动袭击时，“美国总统已经就能源停火发表了声明”，并称“越来越明显的是，俄罗斯不愿接受美国提出的能源停火安排，并打算继续对我们的人民和社区发动恐怖性空袭。”他说，“当俄罗斯看到其战争机器有望获得更高收入时，事情就会变成这样。”
特朗普周日（10月11日）在与俄罗斯达成柴油交易、并与泽连斯基发生激烈争执后，宣布基辅与莫斯科据称已达成一项协议。根据该协议，乌克兰和俄罗斯将停止袭击对方的能源部门。
特朗普在自己的社交平台Truth Social上写道，这项部分停火安排立即生效。“双方都已同意。请遵守协议！”
泽连斯基对这一宣布感到意外。他在接受美国新闻网站Axios采访时首次回应称，这项停火安排对他来说“是个新消息”。不过他表示，如果莫斯科也遵守协议，基辅愿意执行这一停火安排。
欧盟质疑俄罗斯守约意愿
欧盟外交与安全政策高级代表卡拉斯（Kaja Kallas）对特朗普宣布的停火安排持怀疑态度。
在卢森堡举行的欧盟外长会议召开前，卡拉斯表示：“如果能源停火确实得到遵守，我们对此表示欢迎。”她补充说：“但到目前为止，我们还没有看到俄罗斯也会遵守这一安排的迹象。”
卡拉斯强调，能源停火“极其重要”，因为“今年冬天将会很冷”。
她还指出，俄罗斯拥有许多炼油厂，因此能源停火也符合莫斯科自身的利益。
早在9月中旬，特朗普就曾提议，乌克兰和俄罗斯停止袭击对方境内的能源设施，并声称两国已就此达成协议。当时，乌克兰同样对这一提议持开放态度，但俄罗斯并未作出回应。
特朗普面临美国国内压力
数月来，乌克兰一直在加强对俄罗斯能源基础设施的袭击，以回应俄军大规模发动的导弹和无人机袭击。乌方打击目标包括炼油厂和石油储存设施等。
特朗普长期以来一直对乌克兰这些袭击行动感到不满。
11月3日将举行美国国会中期选举。由于生活成本上升，尤其是伊朗战争导致美国燃油价格高企，特朗普所属的共和党正面临巨大压力。
周五（10月9日）特朗普宣布与俄罗斯总统普京达成一项柴油协议。根据该交易，俄罗斯将供应数十万吨柴油。
此举意味着，美国总统无视了西方国家以及美国自身因俄罗斯对乌克兰发动侵略战争而实施的对俄制裁。德国总理默茨（Friedrich Merz）表示，对德国和欧盟而言，特朗普与俄罗斯达成的柴油协议是“绝无可能”接受的。
泽连斯基将特朗普与普京达成的协议称为“不体面”，并称是一项“软弱的决定”。他表示，普京现在可能对乌克兰发动一场“更加残酷的战争”。
特朗普随后要求泽连斯基下台，并表示：“乌克兰是时候换一位新总统了。”
欧盟：新一轮制裁将对俄造成“前所未有的打击”
周一（10月12日）欧盟外长在卢森堡举行会议，批准了迄今规模最大的对俄制裁方案，目标涵盖1000多个与俄军工综合体有关的实体。
德国外交部长瓦德富尔（Johann Wadephul）将对俄新一轮措施形容为对普京发动俄乌战争所实施的“前所未有的制裁打击”：“我们正在让普京更难以继续其违反国际法的侵略战争，也让他通过残酷的轰炸行动，试图拖垮乌克兰平民的冷酷企图更难得逞。”
他表示：“传递的信息很明确：俄罗斯既不可能，也不会赢得这场战争。”
制裁针对哪些对象？
制裁针对约1600名与俄罗斯战争行动有关的个人和企业，以及另外77名个人和团体。后者被认为与欧盟所认定的、在乌克兰被占领土上举行的非法选举有关。
欧盟外交与安全政策高级代表卡拉斯在社交平台X上发文称，这是“自俄罗斯发动战争以来，我们对制裁名单规模最大的一次扩充……其中超过一半的对象与弹道导弹生产链有关”。
她补充说：“我们正在显著增加俄罗斯生产其用于杀害乌克兰人的武器所需的难度、时间和成本。”
不过，波兰总理图斯克（Donald Tusk）似乎暗示制裁力度还需进一步加大，因为战争即将迈入第五个严酷寒冬：“现在，整个西方世界…都应向俄罗斯和普京表明，西方已准备好采取更加果断的手段遏制俄罗斯。”
克里姆林宫：“我们想要的不是停火”
基辅近来不断利用远程打击手段袭击俄罗斯炼油厂和物流设施，以此回应俄罗斯四年半多来对乌克兰城市持续不断的攻击。俄罗斯的袭击包括在连续多个冬季对乌克兰电力和供暖系统发动的持续性破坏行动。
泽连斯基表示，乌克兰当晚没有袭击俄罗斯炼油厂，并愿意同意能源设施停火，但他指出，俄罗斯不会遵守这一安排的迹象“越来越明显”。
他还表示，如果莫斯科同意全面停火60天，乌克兰可以举行选举。战时选举目前处于暂停状态。
俄罗斯方面表示，双方正在就可能达成的能源设施停火安排进行谈判。克里姆林宫发言人佩斯科夫（Dmitry Peskov）称，相关情况将在适当时候进一步公布。不过，他拒绝接受泽连斯基提出的全面停火60天的建议。
佩斯科夫说：“普京总统以及克里姆林宫其他层级的官员已多次表明，我们不想要停火。我们希望实现长期和平，并准备尽一切可能实现这一目标。”

items.title: 争夺欧洲消费者 巴黎车展成中欧车企角力场
items.url: https://www.dw.com/zh/争夺欧洲消费者-巴黎车展成中欧车企角力场/a-79652085?maca=chi-rss-chi-all-1127-rdf
items.description: 今年巴黎车展开幕之际，正值欧盟与中国就混动车达成初步安排。欧洲汽车业凭借一系列新车型和欧盟的支持，试图在与中国车商争夺欧洲市场的竞争中重振旗鼓。
items.content:
争夺欧洲消费者 巴黎车展成中欧车企角力场
2026年10月13日
（德国之声中文网）在今年巴黎国际车展上，来自欧洲的数十款新车型亮相。例如，斯泰兰蒂斯（Stellantis）集团在车展上推出旗下六款新车型，并展示九款概念车。这家法意合资汽车集团旗下有雪铁龙、标致、欧宝和菲亚特等欧洲品牌。
据路透社报道，欧洲车企与中国车企预计总共将在巴黎车展发布多达60款新车型。双方对于欧洲消费者的争夺战正在升温。
今年巴黎车展举办之前不久，欧盟委员会方面的官员刚刚透露，欧盟计划未来为来自中国的混合动力汽车设定进口上限，以进一步遏制中国车涌入欧洲市场的势头。自2024年起，欧盟已经对来自中国的纯电动汽车加征关税。
对于新计划，欧洲车商们表示欢迎。据路透社报道，雷诺首席执行官普罗沃斯特（Francois Provost）表示，从中国大量进口混合动力汽车对欧洲来说“不可持续”。他认为，目前达成协议“比贸易战要好”。
大众汽车首席执行官布鲁姆（Oliver Blume）周日也对该协议表示欢迎。他表示，任何想在欧洲销售汽车的企业都必须在与本土制造商相当的条件下进行，并创造就业机会和附加值。
目前，欧盟正在制定“欧洲制造”标准。法国总统马克龙表示，法国和德国即将对此达成协议。他说，“保护欧洲的生产能力对我们至关重要”。
未来中国混动车在欧洲销量减半？
路透社报道指出，欧盟拟设中国混动车进口上限，可能使中国混动车在欧洲的销量减半。据美国投行杰富瑞（Jefferies）的专家称，该协议可能对比亚迪和名爵（MG）的母公司上汽集团造成最大冲击。今年前八个月，这两家公司占据了欧盟进口混合动力汽车的约90%。
不过，也有汽车行业专业人士认为，欧盟计划的进口上限措施不太可能使中国车商在欧洲的销售业务停滞不前。汽车行业分析咨询公司的专家蒙多兹（Felipe Mundoz）表示，“欧洲现在必须决定是效仿美国的做法，还是任由整个行业被中方收购。”
如今，中国汽车进入美国的道路已经布满荆棘。出于对数据安全的担忧和保护本土就业等考量，美国政府通过大幅加征关税等手段，实质上将中国产的汽车排除出美国市场。
“若没有对欧洲的出口，中国车商会倒闭”
在周一（10月12日）的巴黎车展上，中国制造商扮演着尤其重要的角色。据中国官媒报道，本届车展共有16家中国车企携25个品牌参展，多款新车型在欧洲首秀，“集中展示动力电池、超快充、智能驾驶及人工智能等领域的创新成果”。
路透社的报道指出，此次参展的中国车商数量，是两年前的两倍。这些企业正通过出口来应对中国国内市场产能过剩的问题。由于美国市场对中国车商而言基本关闭，他们更加依赖欧洲这个利润丰厚的出口市场。
据汽车分析师施密特（Matthias Schmidt）的数据显示，第二季度中国制造商在欧洲的市场份额上升至15%；插电式混合动力汽车的市场份额甚至超过了四分之一。
“如果他们（中国汽车制造商）放弃对欧洲的出口，他们就会倒闭，因为他们在其他任何地方都赚不到钱，”世界汽车制造商组织（OICA）秘书长鲁迪埃（Francois Roudier）说。

items.title: 德语媒体：强硬立场已经初见成效
items.url: https://www.dw.com/zh/德语媒体：强硬立场已经初见成效/a-79652052?maca=chi-rss-chi-all-1127-rdf
items.description: 德媒《编辑部网络》评论写道，混动车协议避免了欧中之间一场迫在眉睫的贸易冲突，同时也证明，欧盟只有显示强硬的立场，才能换来北京的让步。《日报》评论认为，混动车领域的协议并不能缓解欧中贸易的严重失衡，对中国产品全面征收反补贴关税可能是欧盟的唯一选项。
items.content:
（德国之声中文网）就欧中达成的混动车协议，新闻平台《编辑部网络》发表评论写道，北京此次做出让步，是迫于欧盟压力的无奈之举，而并非对自身贸易政策的幡然醒悟。这篇题为《欧洲的强硬已经初见成效》的评论写道：
“面对中国，祈求绝不会起到任何作用，只有奋力反击才能达到目的。而这一次欧盟的反击也确实起到了立竿见影的效果：就获得高额补贴的中国混动车进口问题，欧盟和中国终于达成了一项协议，这无疑是一个好兆头。欧盟贸易事务专员谢夫乔维奇宣布，中方有望将其混动车出口量降低一半。谢夫乔维奇在北京取得的这项突破，令许多外交官都感到意外。
长期以来，中国总是以这样的承诺来安抚欧洲人：紧密的经贸关系最终将给双方都带来增长。然而事实却是，中国工业一直是主要的获益方，而欧洲企业承受的压力则越来越大。
现在，北京终于表现出了愿意妥协的姿态，这无疑是一个重要的信号，但各方也不应抱持不切实际的幻想：中方妥协的背后，并不是认识到了自身的不妥，而是纯粹的利益权衡。”
《编辑部网络》评论写道，此前德法两国有关欧盟应设置强硬反制工具的建议，显然产生了足够的威慑力，并最终促使北京在欧中谈判中做出了让步：
“北京面临着两个选择：要么同欧盟共同寻求解决方案，要么在配额和关税的掣肘之下，基本被排除在欧盟混动车市场之外。这个二选一的选择想必并不困难。与其让布鲁塞尔单方面制定规则，北京当然更愿意参与其中。
至此，中国在欧盟峰会召开前夕选择了缓和局势。本周举行的欧盟峰会期间，各国将就欧中贸易失衡问题展开讨论，并有可能会出台新型政策工具。在稀土问题上，北京也同样释放出了让步的信号：原材料出口欧盟许可证的审批程序将被进一步简化。中国试图以此打消欧洲各国政府的疑虑，即中国会以叫停出口作为要挟手段。
欧盟虽然已经取得了不少进展，但这一切还远远不够。市场扭曲等众所周知的老问题仍令欧洲工业压力重重。欧中贸易战虽然暂时得以避免，但双方的争执点仍有很多。”
”德国对华政策的转变促成了北京的让步“
柏林出版的《日报》写道，此次欧中谈判的结果显示，欧洲人手中的筹码，远比那些宿命论者所声称的多很多：
“中国人的让步首先要归因于德国政府的立场转变，因为法国总统马克龙很早以前就已开始敦促以强硬手段回应中国的产业政策了。在此次默茨总理对华政策发挥实质性转向之前，对巴黎发出的倡议，德国历届总理总是极力阻挠。
对于欧洲的汽车工业来说，这项协议给他们提供了急需的喘息机会，以便他们能够重振旗鼓，去应对技术及成本效益方面均占据优势的中国竞争对手。但这项协议并不能让欧洲人从此高枕无忧，毕竟它仅涉及一个混动车领域。涉及单一领域的协定只能导致中国将其巨大的贸易顺差转移至其他领域。
而要想促成持久性的解决方案，只有两条路可走：其一，北京必须让人为压低的人民币升值，并让中国家庭的财力变得更为充裕。只有这样，中国民众的购买力才能提升，中国产品在国际市场的价格也才会被提高。
然而，鉴于中国党和国家领导人习近平对上述改革一直持否定态度，第二条道路或许更有可行性：欧盟对中国产品大幅度征收关税，以抵消不公平的国家补贴所带来的竞争优势。”

items.title: 重庆政坛“不倒翁”黄奇帆落马 卸任近十年后接受中纪委审查
items.url: https://www.dw.com/zh/重庆政坛-不倒翁-黄奇帆落马-卸任近十年后接受中纪委审查/a-79651497?maca=chi-rss-chi-all-1127-rdf
items.description: 重庆市原市长黄奇帆周二被宣布涉嫌严重违纪违法，正接受中央纪委国家监委纪律审查和监察调查。现年74岁的黄奇帆在重庆任职约15年，先后与六任市委书记共事，曾历经薄熙来、孙政才两任书记落马的官场震荡仍屹立不倒，近年以网红经济学家的身份到中国各地发表演讲。
items.content:
重庆政坛“不倒翁”黄奇帆落马 卸任近十年后接受中纪委审查
2026年10月13日
（德国之声中文网）据中共官网中央纪委国家监委网站周二（10月13日）发布的消息，重庆市原市长黄奇帆涉嫌严重违纪违法，目前正接受中央纪委国家监委纪律审查和监察调查。官媒新华社和央视新闻随后发布了报道。
官方通报内容只有简短的一句话，没有公布黄奇帆涉嫌哪些具体的违纪违法情节。
黄奇帆1952年5月出生，浙江诸暨人，曾任重庆市长近7年，并曾任第十八届中央委员。他卸任重庆市长已近十年，此次在离开实职多年后被查，引发外界关注。
据香港《明报》报道，黄奇帆近年以网红经济学家的身份到中国各地发表演讲。由宁波银行杭州分行主办的“新质生产力赋能杭州企业高质量发展论坛”，原定10月26日在杭州一家五星级酒店举行，并邀请黄奇帆担任主讲嘉宾，但突然传出因故取消，引发外界猜测他可能落马。
重庆政坛“不倒翁”：约15年历经六任书记
公开履历显示，黄奇帆早年长期在上海工作。1983年进入上海中共党政机关后，他曾参与浦东开发相关工作。他在上海任职期间，先后在吴邦国、黄菊主政上海时工作，1995年起兼任上海市委副秘书长和市政府副秘书长，其间还曾兼任市委研究室主任、市经济委员会主任等职。
2001年10月，黄奇帆调任重庆副市长，次年当选中共重庆市委常委，此后长期担任常务副市长，分管工业、财税、金融等工作。2009年11月，他出任重庆市委副书记，同年12月任代市长，2010年1月正式当选重庆市长，直至2016年12月卸任，担任市长近7年。
在重庆的约15年间，黄奇帆先后经历贺国强、黄镇东、汪洋、薄熙来、张德江、孙政才六任市委书记，其间发生多次政坛震荡，他却始终留在当地领导班子，并一路升任市长。因此，部分媒体称他为重庆政坛的"不倒翁"。
薄熙来、孙政才先后落马 黄奇帆一度全身而退
黄奇帆的仕途，与重庆政坛历次重大人事变动紧密相连。
薄熙来于2007年至2012年担任重庆市委书记。2012年，他因王立军事件引发的政治风波被撤职，次年以受贿、贪污和滥用职权罪被判处无期徒刑。2010年3月全国"两会"期间，黄奇帆曾用“如鱼得水”形容他与薄熙来的工作关系。
薄熙来被免职后，时任国务院副总理张德江兼任重庆市委书记。2012年11月起，孙政才接替张德江，主政重庆至2017年。孙政才2017年落马，次年因受贿罪被判处无期徒刑。
两任搭档先后倒台，却并未影响黄奇帆的政治生涯。他在薄熙来被撤职后继续担任市长，直到2016年底卸任；2017年2月，转任全国人大财政经济委员会副主任委员，2018年3月卸任。2018年1月，他还当选为第五届重庆市政协委员。
卸任后转型“网红经济学家”
卸任重庆市长后，黄奇帆仍长期活跃于中国财经领域。他以复旦大学特聘教授、中国国际经济交流中心副理事长等身份，频繁出席各类财经论坛，就中国宏观经济、房地产市场、资本市场、金融改革和产业发展等问题发表观点，在财经界知名度颇高，被媒体称为“网红经济学家”。
在重庆任职期间，他长期参与地方财政、金融和产业政策的制定，积极推动当地产业发展和金融改革，因熟悉经济事务而备受关注。
重庆今年已有现任市长被查
黄奇帆并非今年重庆唯一被查的高层官员。今年3月20日，时任重庆市长胡衡华已因"严重违纪违法"被中央纪委国家监委立案审查调查。
胡衡华此前曾任长沙市长、长沙市委书记和陕西省委副书记，2021年12月任重庆代市长，2022年1月正式当选市长。2023年，他因对违法建筑整治和房屋安全隐患排查工作组织领导不力，对2022年长沙“4·29”居民自建房倒塌事故负有领导责任，受到中共党内警告处分。该事故造成50多人死亡。
被查之后，胡衡华于今年5月27日辞去重庆市长职务，6月26日被终止全国人大代表资格。陈新武接任重庆市长。
短短半年多时间里，重庆一现任、一前任两名市长相继被查，显示这座直辖市仍是中共“反腐”的重点区域。

items.title: MI5 chief warns of threats to UK from Russia, Iran and AI
items.description: Sir Ken McCallum says operations to tackle terrorism and state threats are now roughly of an "equal scale".
items.content:
MI5 chief warns of threats to UK from Russia, Iran and AI
- Published
MI5 is devoting more resource to countering state threats than during the Cold War, the head of the intelligence service has said.
Sir Ken McCallum said threats from foreign adversaries had quadrupled in the last decade, with Russia "aggressor number one" as well as increased Iran-linked aggression against Jewish sites and military bases.
At an annual speech in London, MI5's chief said Russia was waging hybrid warfare at a time when AI was "supercharging the cyber-security contest between attackers and defenders".
He also warned of rising threats from "extreme right-wing terrorism" and said MI5 had "caught terrorists seeking to exploit AI," including by integrating the technology with drones.
He said the biggest threat from the misuse of AI was extremist groups using the technology to harness new and existing bioweapons.
However, he noted that work countering terrorism and state threats was now "pretty much of equal scale" which he described as a "huge shift" in recent years.
Sir Ken said Russia had stopped short of "conventional conflict" against Nato and is instead trying to unsettle European countries while its progress in its full-scale invasion of Ukraine is "minimal and horrifically costly".
Hybrid warfare or hybrid attacks are loose terms which tend to describe non-military methods, for example cyber-attacks, sabotage or misinformation, designed to exert pressure and destabilise an adversary.
These are quite often employed using proxies, but Russia always denies involvement in such attacks despite growing evidence to the contrary.
Sir Ken said MI5 successes in identifying and expelling Russian spies from the UK had left the Kremlin dependent on paying proxies for attempted attacks.
"With its traditional covert footprint eviscerated by almost 1,000 expulsions since the invasion, the Kremlin's global toolkit is weak, he said.
"So we see them scrambling to pay criminals to do their bidding."
He added: "These are not the actions of a great power with the strategic upper hand."
His comments come as a growing number of leaders across Europe have warned Russia may be preparing attacks to test their commitment to supporting Ukraine.
Asked after the speech about Prime Minister Andy Burnham's recent comments that Russia interfered with the Brexit referendum, Sir Ken said it was "not new news" that there had been attempts from Moscow but distinguished between "interference attempted" and "outcome achieved".
He said it was a matter of public record that there were pieces in Russian media and "so-called internet trolls and bot farms" seeking to influence the Brexit debate, but also stressed that the result of the 2016 referendum was "not in dispute".
He added that he was "worried" about the the ongoing debate on Russian interference.
"I am a little bit anxious that we don't play into our adversaries' hands by making these trolls look 10ft tall," he told reporters.
Meanwhile, Sir Ken warned that Iran is also expanding a hybrid campaign in the UK.
The intelligence chief said there had been 50 arrests in the last year over Iran-linked activities.
Much of this Iranian aggression has been aimed at Jewish communities, Sir Ken added, and also at "harder targets, like military sites".
Sir Ken did not mention arrests at RAF Fairford directly during his speech, but told reporters afterwards the incident was "not unique".
He added: "We have seen Iranian interest beyond RAF Fairford in the UK."
The incident at the airbase in Gloucesteshire, where three suspicious vans were seen parked nearby, has seen seven people arrested and bailed by counter-terrorism police.
Burnham has said the incident was "almost certainly directed by Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard".
The MI5 head said in his speech: "What I can say is that those who seek to cause mayhem on British streets - whether hired thugs here or their paymasters overseas - will meet an unflinching response."
Sir Ken added that the National Security Act - a 2023 law designed to target people working against UK interests for foreign powers - is in heavy use, and has been employed to tackle threats from China as well as Iran and Russia.
On the emerging threat posed by AI, Sir Ken said: "It can produce propaganda and radicalising material tailored to the individual.
"We've caught terrorists seeking to exploit Al to improve their reconnaissance and attack methodologies, with Al-enabled drones adding a new twist."
Sir Ken said the bioweapons threat posed by AI was "not yet realised" but warned the technology has the "potential to change the stakes".
"These risks are real. The UK Intelligence Community - MI5, GCHQ, MI6 - is working closely with the UK's globally respected AI Security Institute to take them on."
Sir Ken said AI poses unknown threats, telling Thames House: "Put at its simplest, human history has given us no experience of facing an actor which is smarter than we are".
He announced MI5 had launched an AI Threat Assessment Centre, which he said would assess sources and "separate the bluster from the realities".
In April, the UK's terrorism threat level was raised to severe for the first time in five years, meaning an attack is highly likely.
Sir Ken said Islamist groups like Al Qaeda and so-called Islamic State both continue to direct and inspire attacks, while the increased risk was also driven "in significant part" by extreme right-wing terrorism.
He continued: "Over the last year the most marked trend has been an increase in cases where extremist versions of anti-immigration and anti-Muslim grievance are tipping into terrorist intent."
Sir Ken said extreme right-wing terrorism tended to "skew young", driven by the internet - adding that MI5 had in recent months investigated a "radicalised extreme right-wing 13-year-old here in the UK".
He said: "That investigation generated insight that enabled one of our international partners to prevent a lethal attack on their soil."

items.title: Man killed in tiger attack identified as William Chapman
items.description: Chapman, who was in his 20s, died after entering the tiger's enclosure at Yorkshire Wildlife Park.
items.content:
Man killed in tiger attack identified as William Chapman
- Published
The man who was killed by a tiger after entering its enclosure at a wildlife park has been identified as William Chapman, the BBC understands.
Chapman, who visited Yorkshire Wildlife Park near Doncaster on his own, entered the enclosure shortly after 13:30 BST on Saturday and was pronounced dead at the scene, according to South Yorkshire Police.
An eyewitness described seeing him wearing headphones and "pacing around" near the enclosure before he went in. Mobile phone footage, believed to be from Chapman, appears to show the inside of the enclosure as he approaches the tiger across a patch of grass.
A force spokesperson said his family was aware and was being supported by specialist officers.
The park was evacuated after the incident and remains closed as investigations continue.
Chapman, who was in his mid-20s, was a former pupil of the Jackie Palmer Stage School in High Wycombe.
As a child, he appeared in the ITV production May Contain Nuts alongside Shirley Henderson - who is best known for playing Moaning Myrtle in the Harry Potter films - and Darren Boyd.
He also portrayed Edward Jenner in the BBC series True Stories.
In a social media statement, a spokesperson for the stage school said: "We are deeply saddened to hear of the passing of our former student William Chapman.
"Our thoughts and heartfelt condolences are with William's family and friends during this incredibly difficult time.
"We loved watching William grow, both as a person and as a performer, during his time with us.
"It was a privilege to be part of his journey, and he will be remembered with great fondness by everyone who had the pleasure of knowing him."
They added that Chapman would be "truly missed" and he would "always hold a special place in our hearts".
City of Doncaster Council earlier confirmed it had launched a health and safety investigation into Chapman's death, which a spokesperson said was "in line with our statutory duties".
Staff at Yorkshire Wildlife Park said their "thoughts and heartfelt sympathies" were with Chapman's family and confirmed the rare Amur tiger, called Altai, remained in the enclosure and would not be euthanised.
Chapman was reported to have entered the enclosure after climbing down from a walkway.
Those who saw the attack said some witnesses had tried unsuccessfully to distract the tiger.
A video posted on a social media account believed to be Chapman's appears to show the moments before the attack.
In the footage, shot on a mobile phone, the inside of the enclosure can be seen as he approaches the tiger - perched on a wooden platform - across a patch of grass.
The account has since been removed.
A spokesperson for the Born Free Foundation, which campaigns to phase out zoos, called for an "urgent review" into "how the man managed to enter the enclosure and what happened next".
Dr Campbell Murn, a previous member of the government's zoo expert committee and lecturer at the University of Reading, said while it was a tragic incident, determined people could get inside zoo enclosures.
"I view it in the same way a determined thief will get into somebody's house or somebody's car and despite the best security systems and enclosures sometimes these things happen," he said.
Ella Ford, 24, from Moreton, Wirral, had visited the park with her boyfriend and filmed the tiger moments before the attack.
She described seeing Chapman by the tiger enclosure "pacing around with his headphones in".
A few minutes later, she saw he had "climbed up onto the barriers".
A woman was close by talking to him, she said, before "he jumped in and crawled in front of the tiger, where the tiger was perched and just lay there".
Ford said she then witnessed the tiger grab hold of him, and he was "shouting for help".
She estimated about 15 to 20 people were on the enclosure's raised visitor walkway before staff quickly evacuated the area and, shortly afterwards, the park.
She described members of the public as being "confused, like what on earth's going on?"
"I just know some man was obviously trying to bang on the fence to try and deter the tiger away, but it obviously wasn't doing anything," she said.
Karmelle Pelham, 39, from Worksop, had been enjoying a family day out when park staff told them the site was being evacuated.
She said she had heard what sounded like "gunshots" and an air ambulance had circled above.
Pelham added: "There was a big, black tarpaulin over the tiger enclosure."
She praised park staff for their handling of the incident, saying it had been "very, very well organised".

items.title: Football regulator says he would quit over any political interference in Man City case
items.description: The head of English football's independent regulator says he will resign if he encounters any political interference over Manchester City's future.
items.content:
Regulator would quit over Man City interference
- Published
The head of English football's independent regulator says he will resign if he encounters any political interference over the future of Manchester City.
As chairman of the Independent Football Regulator (IFR), David Kogan has the power to assess the suitability of club owners and executives.
If an independent commission's findings that the club broke Premier League financial rules are upheld, the watchdog could even force a sale.
Last month, the Prime Minister Andy Burnham was criticised for saying he would be "really concerned" if the scandal led to Manchester City's Abu Dhabi owners selling the club.
"They've been such a huge partner in the building of modern Manchester and obviously the building of Manchester City into the global force that it is," he added.
When asked about Burnham's comments, Kogan told BBC Sport: "The Prime Minister is entirely entitled to make his own observations on anything.
"We are independent. That is in the name. I am the chairman of the Independent Football Regulator and independence absolutely runs through everything we're doing.
"And no politician has tried to influence and would try to influence anything we do on that."
When asked what he would do if he did come under political pressure over the case, Kogan replied: "I would resign."
An independent commission found City had broken rules over a nine-year period between 2009 and 2018. Owners Abu Dhabi United Group (ADUG) - a private investment company belonging to United Arab Emirates vice-president and deputy prime minister Sheikh Mansour - are said to have topped up the value of commercial deals as part of a "disguised funding scheme" to the scale of £830m.
City insist they are innocent and have appealed.

  - Published12 hours ago
- 'Criticised for what?' - Maresca defends celebrations 
  - Published7 hours ago
Kogan on next steps on Man City
The prime minister initially told the BBC of his concerns, before later denying his reaction had "downplayed the seriousness of the findings".
However, some Premier League clubs were so "astonished" by Burnham's stance that sources told BBC Sport they were "concerned" about political interference in the appeal process.
Burnham's previous role as mayor of Greater Manchester has led to questions about his relationship with City's Abu Dhabi ownership.
Conservative leader Kemi Badenoch demanded all details of meetings between the prime minister and senior figures at the club are released. The government released these details on Monday.
Speaking at the launch of the IFR's State of the Game report, Kogan said, "As far as we, as the regulator, are concerned, we have a very clear course of action that is governed by statute and we are going to follow that course of action, and no comment by any politician or indeed any individual is going to affect what we do".
Kogan's hiring as IFR chair was the subject of an inquiry by the Commissioner for Public Appointments over his historic links to the Labour Party, having contributed money to the leadership campaigns of former Prime Minister Sir Keir Starmer and culture secretary Lisa Nandy.
Shadow Culture Minister Louie French has written to the government, citing "concerns about the IFR's ability to adjudicate this case fairly, free from political interference".
In response, Kogan said: "I can tell you absolutely categorically that any politician who's trying to meddle in this for political purposes is welcome to try and welcome to do it, but I am going to stand by the probity of the organisation that I lead. If anybody wishes to challenge those after we've acted, that's entirely up to them."
'Very serious issues'
The independent panel will hold a sanctions hearing - which could take months to convene - to decide on City's punishment.
The club can appeal both the guilty verdicts and the sanction, leaving the league in a state of uncertainty.
City's punishment could range from a huge fine, being deducted points or being ejected from the Premier League.
Asked how crucial it is that it was resolved as soon as possible, Kogan said: "I think it's very important."
Kogan added that the case was "raising very serious issues if Manchester City on appeal is found to be guilty of the allegations within those findings".
"We are waiting like everybody else to see what the independent panel will do… and then we will bring in a view in terms of our own investigation and statutory powers if we need to do so.
"Our powers relate to individual owners, directors and senior executives. They refer to whether people are in a position to run a club in a way that is safe, coherent and done with probity, and we will be examining those things."
When asked if the IFR could withhold a club license from City when it starts awarding them from next month, Kogan said: "I'm not going to begin to comment on any actions we may take until we've had a chance to assess it."
And on whether the case had raise questions about the state-connected ownership of clubs, Kogan replied: "No, I don't think specifically it does. We have no powers to prevent state ownership of clubs. It's not within our remit. But I don't think you can apply a general observation about type of ownership to one particular example."
An independent commission held a 42-day hearing in 2024 that led to the verdict announced last month, with City also guilty of all charges except one relating to non-cooperation with the Premier League investigation.
The commission's report said that "a number of important club witnesses gave false evidence in key respects and that some knowingly gave untrue and dishonest evidence".

items.title: Pope diagnosed with lung cancer but had successful surgery, Vatican says
items.description: Pope Leo had successful surgery to remove a lower lobe of his right lung, the Vatican said.
items.content:
Pope diagnosed with lung cancer but had successful surgery, Vatican says
- Published
Pope Leo XIV has been diagnosed with lung cancer but had successful surgery to remove a lower lobe of his right lung, the Vatican has said in a medical bulletin.
The 71-year-old underwent a 90 minute surgery on Tuesday at Rome's Gemelli Hospital and was subsequently diagnosed with lung adenocarcinoma.
"After the operation, the Pope awoke normally and returned after a brief period of observation to his room on the 10th floor," the Vatican said in a statement.
The lump was first detected during what the Vatican has described as "routine checks".
Earlier, large crowds gathered outside the hospital to greet the Pope, with some waiting for several hours.
They cheered greetings and well wishes as he passed, while he waved and smiled back through the lowered back window of his car.
He was then met by staff on the hospital steps. "I'm sorry," one of them commiserated, to which the Pope gave a smile and a shrug. "We're here for you," he was assured.
In its statement, the Vatican said the whole lower lobe of the Pope's right lung was removed "to ensure the procedure was radical".
A Vatican source told Agence France-Presse news agency further tests were being carried out to see if there was any sign the cancer had spread.
It was Leo XIV himself who on Sunday announced news of his operation to the world, speaking from the balcony in St Peter's Square after delivering the traditional Angelus blessing.
He said the nodule, or growth, on his lung was "contained" and had been found "at a very early stage", but that doctors had advised him to have it removed.
Gemelli's thoracic surgery team operated on the Pope, whose schedule has already been cleared until 20 October to give him time to recover.
Nodules are quite common and not necessarily cancerous, but after it was examined the medical team confirmed it was pulmonary adenocarcinoma, "as suspected by pre-operative tests", the Vatican said.
The Vatican has stressed that the pontiff, who is generally thought to be fit, had no symptoms of infection or illness.
Cardinal Kikuchi Tarcisio Isao of Tokyo wrote on social media that he'd had an audience with Pope Leo on Monday, and said the pontiff felt "nothing wrong" physically.
He said the Pope had decided to check in for surgery as soon as possible because he was due to travel to Latin America in early November, and was keen to stick to that plan.
The trip is particularly significant because it includes a visit to Peru, where the pontiff was a missionary and then a Bishop for many years.
Despite all the reassurances, the news has shaken Catholics all over the world.
"Am I worried? Yes, because I certainly wasn't expecting anything like this," Vatican Secretary of State Cardinal Parolin told journalists on Tuesday.
He agreed that the news was like a "bolt from the blue", but said the cardinals had been struck by the Pope's "serenity" and were confident in his recovery.
Outside Gemelli Hospital, which has treated several popes and is home to a large statue of John Paul II, a few Catholics lingered after the pontiff was admitted.
Carla had come specially, wanting to be close.
"He seems calm, so we are calm too - even though illness is always unpleasant," she told the BBC. "We will wait here and pray."
"I was in St Peter's Square when he made the announcement, and I felt really awful," said Elsa, who was also present. "I was really taken aback," she said, explaining that when Pope Leo was elected she had thought he was a younger, healthier pontiff.
"It turns out he's vulnerable too," she added.

items.title: Cornell bans all fraternity parties over gang sex assault allegations
items.description: The school has faced an uproar over how it handled assault allegations brought by a woman known as Jane Doe.
items.content:
Cornell bans all fraternity parties over gang sex assault allegations
- Published
Cornell University is banning all parties at fraternity houses as the school faces backlash over its handling of an alleged sexual assault on campus two years ago.
Last month, a woman known as Jane Doe filed a lawsuit alleging she was plied with drugs and raped by several men in 2024 at a party at a Cornell fraternity house.
In a statement on Tuesday, Cornell's president, Michael Kotlikoff, announced a series of measures responding to the alleged assault, including the end to fraternity parties for the rest of the school year.
"I am deeply sorry for the harm Jane Doe suffered in 2024, and appalled that this act of sexual violence occurred within our Cornell community," he said.
"It is clear that women on our campus continue to question whether they are safe. We must meet this moment by acknowledging where we have fallen short and taking meaningful action," he added.
Fraternities have existed at university campuses across the US for decades and function as all-male social clubs where the students live, study and socialise. Over the years, the groups have become notorious for binge-drinking, partying and dangerous hazing rituals.
In a statement, a lawyer representing Doe said she filed a civil lawsuit "to achieve her aim of improving Cornell and its response to abuse claims".
"While the steps announced today are helpful to achieve this goal, they are too late to protect Ms. Doe," said lawyer Thomas Giuffra.
Cornell's president said anyone who violated the new fraternity party policy at the New York university would be suspended.
The school also said it planned to improve support for survivors of sexual assault, including more staff to help people report sexual misconduct and navigate other support systems as well.
Through Title IX, the federal law that governs how universities handle sexual assault claims, schools are required to provide measures of support to help survivors stay in school after assaults. Doe's lawyer has said she dropped out after the alleged assault.
The president said the school will allow New York State Police's trauma-informed officers to investigate allegations of sexual assault on its campus.
These officers will interview survivors who want to pursue criminal charges and prepare "comprehensive investigative summaries for the appropriate law enforcement agency", Kotlikoff said.
Cornell has faced criticism over the information shared with the local district attorney's office about Jane Doe's allegations.
Out of hundreds of documents that US media outlets have obtained from Cornell's investigation into the assault, Tompkins County District Attorney Matthew Van Houten said that in 2024, his office received only a six-page statement signed by the victim as well as Snapchat messages in which the men at the fraternity party advertised a free sexual encounter with Doe.
State officials have also criticised Van Houten's decision not to bring charges or interview victims and witnesses himself. New York Governor Kathy Hochul has appointed the state's attorney general, Letitia James, to investigate the case.
Kotlikoff said Cornell would be bringing in national sexual violence prevention experts to examine "the factors leading to campus sexual violence and strategies to promote responsible sexual citizenship".
He said the steps were the first toward "systematic change" on campus.

Watch Trump arrive in New York for his arraignment
1:18
What we covered here
Former President Donald Trump arrived in New York City Monday, a day before he is expected to turn himself in to law enforcement and face more than 30 criminal charges in a Manhattan court following last week’s historic grand jury indictment.
Trump’s legal team said the former president will voluntarily surrender and will look to challenge “every potential issue” once the indictment is unsealed.
Trump, who has vowed to continue his 2024 bid, is the first current or former president in US history who has faced criminal charges. The district attorney’s office has been investigating Trump’s alleged role in a hush money payment scheme involving adult film star Stormy Daniels that dates to the 2016 presidential election.
Trump arraignment has "unparalleled public interest," but it won't be broadcast, judge says
From CNN's Tierney Sneed
Acting New York Supreme Court Judge Juan Merchan wrote his Monday night order that the media’s request to broadcast the arraignment of former President Donald Trump was understandable, but that the news organizations’ interests in providing the broadest possible access to the proceedings must be weighed against “competing interests.”
In rejecting the request to broadcast the arraignment live on television, Merchan still wrote about the historical significance of the proceeding in stark terms.

Judge will only briefly allow photos in the courtroom before Trump arraignment begins
From CNN's Tierney Sneed
News outlets will not be allowed to broadcast former President Donald Trump’s arraignment on Tuesday in a New York state court, a judge said Monday night, but he will allow some photographers to take pictures in the courtroom before the proceedings formally begin.
Acting New York Supreme Court Judge Juan Merchan rejected the request by several media organizations, including CNN, for permission to broadcast the historic proceedings. Trump’s arraignment — like most arraignments in the Manhattan courthouse — is a public proceeding, but news cameras are not usually allowed to broadcast from inside the courtroom.
However, the judge is allowing five pool photographers to take still photos at the beginning of the proceedings “until such time as they are directed to vacate the jury box by court personnel.”
Earlier on Monday, Trump’s lawyers urged the judge to reject the media’s request for live cameras in the courtroom. The Manhattan District Attorney’s office told the judge they didn’t have a position.
The media outlets that tried to get cameras into the courtroom argued that “the gravity of this proceeding … and, consequently, the need for the broadest possible public access, cannot be overstated.”
The arraignment is also expected to bring the unsealing of the criminal charges against Trump, which have not yet been seen by his lawyers or the public.
The indictment stems from Manhattan District Attorney Alvin Bragg’s investigation into hush-money payments, made during the 2016 presidential campaign, to women who claimed they had extramarital affairs with Trump, which he denies.
Trump denies all wrongdoing and his lawyers said last week that they’ll fight to get the charges dropped.

Tuesday is the first test for Trump to navigate a legal and political strategy
From CNN's Jeff Zeleny
Donald Trump is not planning to speak publicly in New York on Tuesday, aides say, if he follows advice from members of his legal team who have urged the former President to refrain from the vitriol he’s been directing toward the prosecutor and judge presiding over the case.
But that restraint does not extend to Florida, aides said, where he is planning to deliver a full-throated defense of his New York case as well as other investigations he is facing during a prime time address from Mar-a-Lago on Tuesday night.
It’s the first test to see whether Trump can navigate two vasty different approaches to his legal case and his political campaign, which are now inextricably linked.

Trump is "ready to go in and do what he needs to do tomorrow," attorney says
From CNN's Mary Kay Mallonee
Alina Habba, lawyer for former President Donald Trump, gives an interview outside of Trump Tower on March 21 in New York City.
(Michael M. Santiago/Getty Images)
Alina Habba, who represents Donald Trump in several civil matters, spent time with the former president in New York today and said, “He’s in good spirits. Honestly, he’s as he normally would be. He’s ready to go in and do what he needs to do tomorrow.”
Habba — appearing on on Fox News’ “Jesse Watters” — was asked about the “game plan” for Trump’s appearance in court in Manhattan Tuesday and said, “It’s all mapped out.”
She added, “Barring any surprises, I think that it should be smooth. We’re trying to coordinate and cooperate with everybody to make sure that there are no problems.”
On whether Trump can get a fair trial in Manhattan, Habba said, “No, no. I think it’s very difficult. I’d like to have faith in this state, but I’ve been practicing for him now for a couple years and gone to court in New York for a few years, and I can tell you, it’s not the same as representing anybody else.”

The former president met with attorneys at Trump Tower on the eve of his arraignment
From CNN's Kristen Holmes
From left to right: Susan Necheles, Todd Blanche and Joe Tacopina.
(Reuters/Getty Images)
Former President Donald Trump met with his attorneys Susan Necheles and Joe Tacopina at Trump Tower after arriving in New York City Monday, a source familiar with the meeting told CNN.
It is unclear if the newest addition to Trump’s New York legal team, Todd Blanche, attended the meeting.
Trump is expected to be arraigned Tuesday.

From CNN's Photo Desk
Former President Donald Trump has landed in New York’s La Guardia Airport ahead of his expected Tuesday arraignment in a Manhattan courthouse.
History was made Thursday when he was indicted by a New York grand jury. It’s the first time that a current or former US president has been criminally charged.
The Manhattan district attorney’s office has been investigating Trump’s alleged role in a hush money payment scheme and cover-up involving adult film star Stormy Daniels that dates to the 2016 presidential campaign.
Trump’s attorney said he plans to file “substantial” legal challenges. The former president has repeatedly denied wrongdoing in the matter and accused Democrats of targeting him politically.

Former president poised to huddle with advisers at Trump Tower
From Jeff Zeleny
A supporter of former President Donald Trump holds a "Trump Won" sign outside of Trump Tower in New York on Monday, April 3.
(Alex Kent/Bloomberg/Getty Images)
A small group of supporters chanted as former President Donald Trump arrived at his namesake tower on Monday afternoon, with a handful of people waving banners with messages like “Trump won” and “Arrest Biden.”
While Trump couldn’t see his admirers as he entered a side door on 56th Street, his arrival came with more fanfare and security than at any other time in his post presidency.
Now that he is inside the building — where he launched his presidential bid nearly eight years ago — Trump is expected to meet with lawyers and political advisers on the eve of his arraignment, an aide told CNN.
Trump’s mood was described by an adviser as “defiant and focused,” as he watched expansive television coverage while flying back to his native New York City from Florida.

Special counsel has secured evidence of how Trump handled classified records at Mar-a-Lago, sources say
From CNN's Katelyn Polantz and Evan Perez
Special counsel prosecutors have secured evidence including daily notes, texts, emails and photographs and are focused on cataloging how Donald Trump handled classified records around the Mar-a-Lago resort and those who may have witnessed the former president with them, according to multiple sources familiar with the investigation.
The new details come amid signs the Justice Department is taking steps that are typically near the end of an investigation.
The recent investigative activity before a federal grand jury in Washington, DC, also includes subpoenaing witnesses in March and April who had previously spoken to investigators, the sources said. While the FBI interviewed many aides and workers at Mar-a-Lago nearly a year ago voluntarily, grand jury appearances are transcribed and under oath — an indication the prosecutors are locking in witness testimony.
The focus of both the mishandling of records and obstruction of justice probes has remained on the actions of the former president, the sources say. That includes prosecutors pursuing evidence of Trump’s intent to keep classified records after he left the White House, plus his knowledge that the records remained in his possession after the Justice Department demanded their return last May.
Witnesses are being questioned about what they saw in Trump’s private residential and work areas within the club, some of the sources said.
